stem.text: The diagram shows the simplified structure of an antibody.

stem.alt: Simplified Y-shaped antibody drawing with two upper arms each showing a light and heavy chain, a stem, and labels X, U, V and W.

A.text: U and X allow the antibody to bind to two different antigens.

B.text: V allows the antibody to be flexible to bind to two antigens.

C.text: W can bind to one specific antigen.

D.text: X can bind with a specific phagocyte receptor.
